title: Lemon chicken with couscous and roast veg
summary: Bright, simple and high in protein.
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C. Peel the butternut and cut it into cubes about 2 cm across, and cut the pepper into strips.
Toss them with half the oil, salt and pepper on a baking tray and roast for 25 minutes, turning once, until soft and golden at the edges.
Meanwhile rub the chicken with the rest of the oil, lemon juice and zest, crushed garlic, dried oregano, salt and pepper.
Grill or pan-fry it over medium-high heat for 5 to 7 minutes a side, until no pink remains in the thickest part. Rest it for 5 minutes, then slice.
Make the couscous: pour the same volume of boiling water over it with a pinch of salt, cover for 5 minutes and fluff it with a fork.
Serve the chicken and vegetables on the couscous with a squeeze of lemon.
